svg.title: ETF Agent V3: six request processing stages with capability owners
svg.desc: Dark cells identify primary responsibility; light cells show other stages; gaps indicate no direct participation. Financial owners are grouped into one tool family.

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC, Noto Sans SC, sans-serif

svg.text: ETF Agent V3 | Six Stages from Prompt to Visible Answer

svg.text: Follow one request across six stages; capability names appear in the cells, not opaque IDs.
